name: keepseek
description: AI-powered coding agent for VS Code

commands.title: KeepSeek: Add Current File to Context
KeepSeek: Add Workspace Files to Context
KeepSeek: Add External Files to Context
KeepSeek: Add Explorer Folder to Chat

keepseek.selectedSourceId.markdownDescription: Source ID paired with `keepseek.selectedModelId` for the selected model. This is model identity, not a globally active source.

keepseek.selectedModelId.markdownDescription: Selected model for the current workspace. An empty or unavailable value adopts the global default model, or the first available model when no explicit default is valid.

keepseek.thinkingEnabled.markdownDescription: Enable Thinking mode for the current workspace.

keepseek.reasoningEffort.markdownDescription: Thinking effort for the current workspace.

keepseek.compressionThreshold.markdownDescription: Automatic history compaction threshold for the current workspace: 70% early cleanup, 80% balanced, or 85% cache first.

keepseek.maxFileBytes.markdownDescription: Maximum bytes KeepSeek reads from one referenced or workspace text file. Binary, media, archive, and otherwise unreadable files are still rejected.

keepseek.patch.maxPayloadBytes.markdownDescription: Maximum encoded size of one patch tool payload. Independent from keepseek.maxFileBytes.

keepseek.patch.maxHunks.markdownDescription: Maximum number of canonical patch hunks or file operations in one patch request.

keepseek.patch.maxChangedBytes.markdownDescription: Maximum total added plus removed bytes in one text patch. The target file itself may be larger.

keepseek.patch.maxInlineBytes.markdownDescription: Maximum old or new bytes allowed inline in one canonical patch hunk. Larger local changes must be split safely or use an explicitly bounded full replacement.

keepseek.patch.maxProviderBufferBytes.markdownDescription: Maximum whole-file fallback buffer for non-file VS Code FileSystemProvider patch targets.

keepseek.patch.maxBackupBytes.markdownDescription: Maximum content-addressed backup size for delete and full-file replacement operations.

keepseek.patch.maxChangeSetArtifactBytes.markdownDescription: Maximum checkpoint and blob bytes retained by one active ChangeSet.

keepseek.patch.blobStoreQuotaBytes.markdownDescription: Global quota for raw content-addressed rollback blobs. Safe garbage collection removes only unreferenced blobs.

keepseek.patch.maxDiffBytes.markdownDescription: Maximum file size for a normal full diff preview; larger patch edits use a hunk-only review document.

keepseek.providerInlineResultMaxChars.markdownDescription: Maximum characters a newly produced tool result may inline into one Provider request. Dynamic context admission may choose a smaller envelope. This does not limit workspace reads or evidence storage.

keepseek.subagent.handoffPreviewBytes.markdownDescription: Maximum UTF-8 bytes previewed in one child-result manifest. The full accepted result remains pageable in isolated storage. / 单个子代理结果清单内联预览的 UTF-8 字节上限；完整结果仍保存在隔离存储中并可分页读取。

keepseek.subagent.parallelHandoffBytes.markdownDescription: Total UTF-8 byte budget shared fairly by all previews in one parallel child handoff. Status and result references are reserved first. / 一次并行子代理 handoff 的 UTF-8 总预算；先保留全部状态和引用，再公平分配预览。

keepseek.evidenceMaxBytes.markdownDescription: Maximum bytes stored for one immutable tool-evidence result. Independent from the workspace read safety limit and Provider inline admission.

keepseek.agent.maxExecutionMs.markdownDescription: Maximum time per root logical Agent task, shared with child agents and recovery. Default 15 minutes; explicitly set 0 for unlimited. / 根逻辑任务、子代理及恢复共享的最长时间，默认 15 分钟；仅显式设为 0 时不限时。

keepseek.agent.subagentMaxExecutionMs.markdownDescription: Maximum time for one child Agent, additionally bounded by its root task. Default 5 minutes. / 单个子代理最长时间，且仍受根任务限制，默认 5 分钟。

keepseek.agent.maxModelRequests.markdownDescription: Maximum physical Provider attempts per root logical run, including retries, recovery, continuation, repair, summary and finalization. / 根逻辑任务的物理 Provider 请求上限，包含重试、恢复、续写、修复、摘要和收尾。

keepseek.agent.subagentMaxModelRequests.markdownDescription: Maximum physical Provider attempts per child Agent. / 单个子代理的物理 Provider 请求上限。

keepseek.agent.maxContinuations.markdownDescription: Maximum automatic continuations after length or pause_turn stops. / length 或 pause_turn 后自动续写的次数上限。

keepseek.agent.maxContextEpochRollovers.markdownDescription: Maximum Context Epoch rollovers in one logical run. Tool budgets never trigger rollover. / 单个逻辑任务的 Context Epoch rollover 上限；工具预算不会触发 rollover。

keepseek.agent.maxTreeUpstreamTokens.markdownDescription: Maximum upstream tokens reserved or reported by a root run and all child agents combined. / 根任务及全部子代理合计的上游 token 上限。

keepseek.agent.subagentMaxUpstreamTokens.markdownDescription: Maximum upstream tokens for one child Agent, additionally bounded by the shared tree limit. / 单个子代理的上游 token 上限，且仍受共享树级上限限制。

keepseek.agent.toolMaxOutputTokens.markdownDescription: Maximum output tokens for an ordinary tool-decision request. / 普通工具决策请求的最大输出 token。

keepseek.agent.finalMaxOutputTokens.markdownDescription: Maximum output tokens for the final answer or one budget finalization request. / 最终回答或预算收尾请求的最大输出 token。

keepseek.agent.continuationMaxOutputToke.markdownDescription: Per-request and cumulative automatic continuation output limit. / 自动续写的单次及累计输出 token 上限。

keepseek.agent.repairMaxOutputTokens.markdownDescription: Maximum output tokens for hidden summary and format/recovery repair requests. / 隐藏摘要及格式/恢复修复请求的最大输出 token。

keepseek.agent.maxCost.markdownDescription: Maximum accounted Provider cost per logical Agent task and billing currency, shared with child agents and recovery. 0 = unlimited. A positive value fails closed when the selected source cannot provide priced usage. / 每项逻辑任务、每种计费币种的 Provider 费用上限；子代理与恢复共享，0 不限额。来源不能提供可计费用量时正值配置会安全拒绝请求。

keepseek.agent.streamIdleTimeoutMs.markdownDescription: Opt-in automatic disconnect after no network data, including while waiting for response headers. 0 waits conservatively. Silence does not prove failure. / 显式开启静默断开；0 保守等待，静默不等于失联。

keepseek.background.maxDurationMs.markdownDescription: Legacy explicit background execution budget. Combined with agent.maxExecutionMs using the smaller positive value; 0 unlimited. / 兼容旧版显式后台时间预算。

keepseek.draftRun.timeoutMs.markdownDescription: Default and maximum time allowed for one explicitly approved DraftRun command. A shorter timeout proposed by the Agent is honored.

keepseek.draftRun.maxTranscriptBytes.markdownDescription: Maximum merged stdout/stderr bytes retained in the DraftRun card and appended to later Agent context. The dedicated DraftRun terminal receives the complete live stream.

keepseek.maxWorkspaceToolFiles.markdownDescription: Maximum candidate files enumerated by read-only workspace list and fallback text-search tools. Search results have a separate per-call result limit.

keepseek.slimToolModeEnabled.markdownDescription: Expose only a smaller core Agent tool schema, adding tools that match the current prompt. Defaults to off so the exposed tool set stays constant across turns and DeepSeek prompt-cache prefixes stay stable. Core workspace text search is available either way.

keepseek.promptCacheTtlMinutes.markdownDescription: Conservative provider prompt-cache TTL. KeepSeek rewrites archived history only after this cold boundary, a provider/model change, or unavoidable context compaction.

keepseek.context.totalBudgetTokens.markdownDescription: Shared token budget for project instructions, activated Skills, legacy memory, and attached context files before they enter a session.

keepseek.projectInstructions.contextBudg.markdownDescription: Maximum estimated tokens used by root AGENTS.md project instructions in each Agent run.

keepseek.skills.contextBudgetChars.markdownDescription: Maximum total characters used by activated Codex-compatible Skill instructions in each Agent run. Skill scripts are never executed.

keepseek.skills.maxImplicitActivations.markdownDescription: Maximum number of allowImplicit Skills that deterministic request matching may activate per Agent run.

keepseek.contextCompression.description: Enable context compression for long sessions

keepseek.thinking.description: Show model reasoning content in chat UI

keepseek.enableCache.description: Enable API caching for reduced latency and cost

scripts.package: vsce package --dependencies --out keepseek-${npm_package_version}.vsix && node scripts/verify-vsix.js keepseek-${npm_package_version}.vsix
